relay.session.list.search_placeholder.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.list.search_placeholder.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The list body's search field; the section headings themselves are relay.shell chrome.

relay.session.list.empty_hint.role: formatted empty-list hint under the placeholder
relay.session.list.empty_hint.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.list.empty_hint.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered under relay.shell.list.empty; the two together answer 'nothing here, and where to go'.

relay.session.list.no_matches.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.list.no_matches.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown when every list section is empty, i.e. a query matched nothing or every row was pinned away.

relay.session.list.start_idle.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.list.start_idle.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. One tap starts a session; the busy state is the sibling key below.

relay.session.list.start_busy.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.list.start_busy.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered while the start request is in flight; paired with relay.session.list.start_idle.

relay.session.view.back.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.view.back.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The ‹ header control's accessible label in the session view (both the connecting and connected headers); the glyph itself is not translated.

relay.session.view.empty_title.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.view.empty_title.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown for a just-started session with no messages, paired with the hint below.

relay.session.view.empty_hint.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.view.empty_hint.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered under relay.session.view.empty_title; hidden once a turn starts streaming.

relay.session.past.back.role: back-to-list accessible name on the history screen
relay.session.past.back.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.past.back.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The ‹ header control's accessible label on the past-sessions screen; the glyph itself is not translated.

relay.session.past.heading.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.past.heading.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The screen's h1.

relay.session.past.search_placeholder.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.past.search_placeholder.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Search covers both session names and conversation bodies.

relay.session.past.loading.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.past.loading.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown while the search response has not landed; distinct from the empty verdict.

relay.session.directory.sheet_title.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.directory.sheet_title.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The composer's directory chip opens this sheet; the title names the surface, not a directory value.

relay.session.directory.path_placeholder.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.directory.path_placeholder.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The fallback for a directory not in the quick-picks.

relay.session.model.sheet_title.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.model.sheet_title.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The sheet that lists the server's ranked models; the rows themselves carry server data, not translated copy.

relay.session.model.filter_placeholder.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase.
relay.session.model.filter_placeholder.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Filters the ranked model list by provider or model name.

relay.session.model.loading.tone: Preserve current copy and casing. The ellipsis is U+2026, not three dots.
relay.session.model.loading.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown while the catalogue response has not landed; the error and empty states are separate keys or daemon copy.

relay.session.model.queued.tone: Preserve current lowercase style of the sheet copy; neutral, reassuring, not an error.
relay.session.model.queued.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown above the composer while a model/effort pick is accepted but the session is still running a turn: the change takes effect before the agent's next model call ('step'), not the next user message. Must not claim the change already applied.

relay.session.model.refused.tone: Plain, operator-facing error; keep lowercase-sheet style where the language allows.
relay.session.model.refused.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The session refused a model/effort pick the phone made (e.g. no credential for that provider). {model} is a provider/model label or an effort rung; {reason} is the session's own sentence and may stay English. Shown until dismissed.

relay.session.temporary_toggle.role: accessible name of the session header's dashed-bubble toggle and label of the ⋮ menu's temporary row
relay.session.temporary_toggle.tone: Sentence case. 'Temporary chat' is the feature name; one term on every surface; never 'ephemeral' or 'incognito'.
relay.session.temporary_toggle.note: A temporary chat is left out of the conversation list and history, and the machine deletes it after a stretch without activity (30 minutes by default). The header toggle shows only on an empty session; aria-pressed carries on/off, so the name does not repeat the state.

relay.session.temporary_subtitle.role: session header subtitle while the chat is temporary
relay.session.temporary_subtitle.tone: Sentence case, terse. Keep the middle dot ' · ' separator.
relay.session.temporary_subtitle.note: {status} is the existing subtitle word or phrase (Idle, Working · 12s, Waiting for you, Ended…). 'Temporary' leads so it is the last part to be truncated on a narrow phone.

relay.session.temporary_keep.role: ⋮ menu row action that turns a temporary chat back into a normal, retained one
relay.session.temporary_keep.note: No confirmation follows: keeping only removes the deletion. 'Chat' is the conversation.

relay.session.temporary_make.role: ⋮ menu row action that makes the current chat temporary
relay.session.temporary_make.tone: Imperative, sentence case. The ellipsis is U+2026 and signals a confirmation follows when the chat has messages.
relay.session.temporary_make.note: Sibling of temporary_keep; exactly one of the two shows.

relay.session.temporary_confirm_title.role: confirmation sheet title before an existing chat becomes temporary
relay.session.temporary_confirm_title.note: Shown only for a chat that already has messages.

relay.session.temporary_confirm_body.role: confirmation sheet body listing what is deleted and what is kept
relay.session.temporary_confirm_body.tone: Plain, calm, factual. Two short sentences.
relay.session.temporary_confirm_body.note: 'Goes quiet' means no activity for the configured window (30 minutes by default). Files the chat changed on the user's computer are NOT deleted — this safety meaning must survive translation.

relay.session.temporary_deleted_title.role: tombstone screen heading shown in place of a temporary chat the machine has deleted
relay.session.temporary_deleted_title.tone: One plain sentence, no blame, no exclamation.
relay.session.temporary_deleted_title.note: Shown when the phone opens, or is still showing, a temporary chat that was deleted after inactivity.

relay.session.temporary_deleted_detail.note: The chat cannot be reopened; files it changed on the computer remain. Safety meaning: nothing on disk was removed.

relay.session.temporary_new.role: tombstone screen primary button: start a new temporary chat
relay.session.temporary_new.note: The user's unsent draft moves into the new chat.

relay.session.back_to_chats.role: tombstone screen secondary button returning to the conversation list
relay.session.back_to_chats.note: Navigates to the phone's conversation list.

relay.session.keep_and_pin.role: remedy button beside a refused pin of a temporary chat
relay.session.keep_and_pin.note: A temporary chat cannot be pinned; this keeps the chat (removes the deletion) and then pins it.

relay.session.keep_and_link.role: remedy button beside a refused project link of a temporary chat
relay.session.keep_and_link.note: A temporary chat cannot be linked to a project; this keeps the chat and then links it.
